> **Important Etiquette Notice:**  
> Swifter is an open-source packaging utility and micro-prefix manager. It wraps and utilizes upstream translation layers (**WineHQ**, **Gcenx**, **DXVK**, **MoltenVK**).  
> - **Swifter issues** (UI bugs, packaging failures, micro-prefix symlink issues, icon extraction errors): Please report them here!
> - **In-game rendering artifacts or engine-level Wine crashes:** These are inherent to upstream Wine/Metal translation. **Please do NOT spam WineHQ, CodeWeavers, or Gcenx issue trackers with Swifter-related reports.**

- **Game Name:** [e.g. Geometry Dash, Digital Tamers 02]

- **Detected Engine:** [e.g. Unity, Godot, GameMaker, Unreal, Generic]
- **Selected Backend:** [DXVK / Apple D3DMetal / Vanilla Wine]

- **Wine Runtime Provider:** [WineHQ Devel (Gcenx) / Whisky / Homebrew / CrossOver]
